newsitem.title: HONG KONG: XINHUA BUYS NEW HONG KONG HQ FROM PEARL.
newsitem.headline: XINHUA BUYS NEW HONG KONG HQ FROM PEARL.

text.p: Luxury property developer and hotelier Pearl Oriental Holdings Ltd said on Monday its Pearl Oriental Centre would be renamed News Building after the sale of 15 floors to China's Xinhua news agency.

Xinhua Estate Ltd, acting on behalf of the news agency, will buy 11 floors of the building in the Wanchai district of Hong Kong island from Pearl Oriental and another four floors and 37 parking spaces from two other vendors, a company spokesman said.
"The total attributable to Pearl Oriental is HK$1.1 billion and the total cost of all floors and parking spaces is HK$1.12 billion," said company secretary Stella Lo.
The building has 24 floors of office space and four levels of parking.
The deal was disclosed in a company announcement issued on May 25 but the buyer was not clarified at that time, Lo said.
The building will become the Hong Kong headquarters for Xinhua news units of the central and provincial governments, Lo said.
Pearl Oriental, which originally planned to set up its headquarters in the building, will stay in Exchange Square in Hong Kong's Central district, Lo said.
"This is just a straight transaction, but we are looking at cooperating on property and infrastructure projects in China in the future," said Lo.
Shares of Pearl Oriental were up HK$0.20 at HK$1.47 in heavy trade of HK$611.48 million.
